formulas.name: Catchment ha to m²
formulas.formula_logic: area_m2 = area_ha * 10000
formulas.guardrails_tests: area_ha >= 0

formulas.name: Rainfall/runoff depth-area to volume
formulas.formula_logic: volume_m3 = area_ha * depth_mm * 10
formulas.guardrails_tests: inputs >= 0

formulas.name: Infiltration canonicalization
formulas.formula_logic: if source_unit='mm/hour': canonical=value; if 'mm/day': canonical=value/24; otherwise block
formulas.inputs_dependencies: source infiltration value + explicit source unit
formulas.guardrails_tests: never infer missing unit; preserve source value/unit/conversion

formulas.name: Evaporation canonicalization — monthly mean daily
formulas.formula_logic: Standard controlled input is mean daily evaporation in mm/day for each calendar month; canonical value = source value. Non-standard mapped imports require explicit unit conversion.
formulas.inputs_dependencies: monthly mean daily evaporation value + declared/mapped source unit
formulas.guardrails_tests: standard workbook unit is fixed mm/day; no unit guessing

formulas.name: m³ to Billion Litres
formulas.formula_logic: kpi_bl = kpi_m3 / 1000000
formulas.guardrails_tests: preserve unrounded m3 and BL internally

formulas.name: Average slope
formulas.formula_logic: slope_percent = (high_elevation_m - low_elevation_m) / horizontal_distance_m * 100
formulas.guardrails_tests: distance > 0; high >= low

formulas.name: Estimated backwater length
formulas.formula_logic: backwater_m = structure_height_m / slope_percent * 100
formulas.guardrails_tests: slope_percent > 0; physical MB measurement preferred; estimation requires rationale/evidence

formulas.name: Capacity method router
formulas.formula_logic: select active capacity formula family from frozen Design 1 structure map and catalog version
formulas.guardrails_tests: no free-text formula; route/version must be recorded

formulas.name: Legacy effective length
formulas.formula_logic: effective_length_m = length_m * effective_length_fraction
formulas.guardrails_tests: 0 <= fraction <= 1

formulas.name: Legacy storage plan area
formulas.formula_logic: storage_area_m2 = storage_width_or_backwater_m * effective_length_m
formulas.guardrails_tests: inputs > 0; selected width/backwater source disclosed

formulas.name: Legacy gross physical capacity
formulas.formula_logic: if family='FULL': gross_m3 = storage_area_m2 * height_depth_m; if family='HALF': gross_m3 = 0.5 * storage_area_m2 * height_depth_m
formulas.guardrails_tests: family must come from frozen Design 1 map; inputs > 0

formulas.name: Recorded vs calculated reconciliation
formulas.formula_logic: variance_m3 = recorded_capacity_m3 - calculated_capacity_m3; variance_pct = variance_m3 / calculated_capacity_m3 when calculated_capacity>0
formulas.guardrails_tests: zero denominator => percent not calculable; configured tolerance creates warning, not silent override

formulas.name: Silt-loss method router
formulas.formula_logic: prefer surveyed volume/stage-storage loss; use depth-loss proxy only when surveyed volume loss unavailable and fallback is selected
formulas.guardrails_tests: exactly one route; fallback disclosed

formulas.name: Silt-adjusted net capacity
formulas.formula_logic: volume route: net=max(0,gross-surveyed_volume_loss); depth route: net=max(0,gross*(1-applied_silt_fraction))
formulas.inputs_dependencies: gross_capacity_m3, selected silt route, surveyed_volume_loss_m3 or applied_silt_fraction
formulas.guardrails_tests: loss <= gross; silt fraction 0..1; routes never additive

formulas.name: Capacity lineage disclosure
formulas.formula_logic: attach capacity_catalog_version + rule_set_version + structure_family + selected silt route to result
formulas.guardrails_tests: mandatory for every capacity result

formulas.name: Incremental capacity — post minus baseline
formulas.formula_logic: incremental_m3 = max(0, post_intervention_capacity_m3 - baseline_capacity_m3)
formulas.guardrails_tests: selected only for route A; never add REJ-002; full pre-existing capacity excluded

formulas.name: Incremental capacity — verified desilted volume
formulas.formula_logic: incremental_m3 = max(0, verified_desilted_volume_m3)
formulas.guardrails_tests: selected only for route B; never add REJ-001

formulas.name: First-monsoon rule
formulas.formula_logic: if monsoon_number_since_new_or_verified_reset == 1: applied_silt_fraction = 0
formulas.guardrails_tests: record system assumption; reset requires verified event

formulas.name: Required sample size
formulas.formula_logic: required_sample = max(ceil(0.10 * eligible_population), 5)
formulas.inputs_dependencies: eligible population by block and structure type
formulas.guardrails_tests: calculate independently by block/type; first-rainfall exclusions handled consistently

formulas.name: Average sampled depth
formulas.formula_logic: avg_depth_m = mean(D1,D2,D3,D4,D5)
formulas.guardrails_tests: all five readings required for this route; each >=0

formulas.name: Positive depth-loss rate
formulas.formula_logic: silt_fraction = (original_depth_m - average_silted_depth_m) / original_depth_m
formulas.guardrails_tests: original_depth >0; negative result triggers review, not silent clamp; applied fraction ultimately 0..1

formulas.name: Block/type sampled average
formulas.formula_logic: block_type_rate = mean(valid sampled structure silt fractions)
formulas.inputs_dependencies: valid sampled structure rates, block, structure type
formulas.guardrails_tests: sample compliance disclosed

formulas.name: Assessment-age validity
formulas.formula_logic: calculate age of latest pre-monsoon assessment; annual recommended; flag when >3 years
formulas.guardrails_tests: retain older assessment; never erase lineage

formulas.name: Year-3 cumulative assumption
formulas.formula_logic: if approved Year-3 assumption used and no reassessment: applied_fraction=min(1, 2*year2_fraction)
formulas.guardrails_tests: 0..1; issue reassessment warning

formulas.name: Verified reset
formulas.formula_logic: reset monsoon counter/silt baseline only after verified repair/desilting event
formulas.guardrails_tests: no automatic reset without evidence

formulas.name: Annual residual runoff fraction
formulas.formula_logic: residual_fraction = cumulative_overflow_m3 / cumulative_generated_runoff_m3
formulas.guardrails_tests: generated runoff = 0 => null/not calculable; expose numerator/denominator

formulas.name: Method 1 effective catchment
formulas.formula_logic: effective_ha = free_ha + upstream_residual_fraction * overlapping_ha
formulas.guardrails_tests: upstream processed first; directed acyclic network required

formulas.name: Method 2 effective catchment
formulas.formula_logic: effective_ha = free_ha + 0.20 * intercepted_ha
formulas.guardrails_tests: non-negative; method recorded

formulas.name: Method 3 effective catchment
formulas.formula_logic: effective_ha = free_ha
formulas.guardrails_tests: non-negative; conservative route

formulas.name: Farm pond/bund alternate catchment
formulas.formula_logic: effective_ha = verified adjoining higher-elevation farmland area
formulas.guardrails_tests: only farm pond/bund when normal delineation infeasible; evidence mandatory

formulas.name: Cascade processing order
formulas.formula_logic: topologically sort upstream→downstream before Method 1; reject cycles
formulas.guardrails_tests: cycle/unresolved link => affected-network block

formulas.name: Daily rainfall series preparation
formulas.formula_logic: filter to selected calculation window; sort by date; require one station-date record; preserve missing dates as null gaps
formulas.guardrails_tests: no silent imputation, duplicate merge, or missing-to-zero; gaps block only dependent structures

formulas.name: Rainfall source selection
formulas.formula_logic: select nearest station OR same hydrological/administrative zone OR documented expert selection
formulas.inputs_dependencies: station metadata, structure/catchment location, selection method/rationale
formulas.guardrails_tests: selection method and rationale visible; distance retained where calculable

formulas.name: First-day DDW state
formulas.formula_logic: if R>64 => Wet; else if R<5 => Dry; else => Damp
formulas.guardrails_tests: first chronological day only

formulas.name: Global Wet trigger
formulas.formula_logic: later day: if R>=64 => Wet before state-specific transitions
formulas.guardrails_tests: precedence fixed and tested

formulas.name: Global Dry trigger
formulas.formula_logic: later day: if R<=3 => Dry before state-specific transitions
formulas.guardrails_tests: precedence fixed and tested

formulas.name: Border 3–5 mm rule
formulas.formula_logic: if 3<R<=5 => Dry unless previous state is Damp
formulas.guardrails_tests: chronological previous state required

formulas.name: Dry→Damp transition
formulas.formula_logic: from Dry: Damp if current>6 OR sum3>12 OR sum7>25 OR sum10>38
formulas.guardrails_tests: window-start behavior tested; no missing-day windows

formulas.name: Damp→Wet transition
formulas.formula_logic: from Damp: Wet if current>8 OR sum2>12 OR sum3>25 OR sum5>38
formulas.guardrails_tests: window-start behavior tested

formulas.name: Damp→Dry transition
formulas.formula_logic: from Damp: Dry if current<3 OR sum3<6 OR sum7<12 OR sum10<15
formulas.guardrails_tests: precedence preserved and golden-tested

formulas.name: Wet→Damp transition
formulas.formula_logic: from Wet: Damp if current<4 OR sum2<6 OR sum4<12 OR sum5<20
formulas.guardrails_tests: precedence preserved and golden-tested

formulas.name: Dry runoff depth
formulas.formula_logic: if state=Dry and R>5: Y=max(0,0.004*R^2 - 0.1088*R + 0.7667); else Y=0
formulas.guardrails_tests: output >=0; calibration status visible

formulas.name: Damp runoff depth
formulas.guardrails_tests: output >=0; calibration status visible

formulas.name: Wet runoff depth
formulas.guardrails_tests: R=100 boundary test; output >=0; calibration status visible

formulas.name: Generated runoff volume
formulas.formula_logic: generated_runoff_m3 = effective_catchment_ha * runoff_depth_mm * 10
formulas.guardrails_tests: inputs/output >=0

formulas.name: Stage-area curve validation
formulas.formula_logic: sort observations by depth; require strictly increasing depth; surface and wetted-base areas >=0; reject duplicate depths
formulas.guardrails_tests: no interpolation until valid; surface area should be nondecreasing unless documented geometry exception
formulas.notes: Added because prior catalog required a 'current depth' but did not fully define how storage maps to depth. Accepted for Design 2 v1.0 freeze. Design 2 v1.1: optional advanced method; no longer required for standard field calculation.

formulas.name: Derived cumulative stage-storage curve
formulas.formula_logic: for adjacent points i-1,i: segment_volume=((surface_area[i-1]+surface_area[i])/2)*(depth[i]-depth[i-1]); cumulative_volume=sum(segment_volume)
formulas.guardrails_tests: piecewise trapezoidal integration; no negative segment; curve begins at lowest observed stage
formulas.notes: Accepted for Design 2 v1.0 freeze. Design 2 v1.1: optional advanced method; no longer required for standard field calculation.

formulas.name: Current stage from stored volume
formulas.formula_logic: locate stored volume within derived cumulative stage-storage brackets and linearly interpolate depth between bracketing cumulative-volume points
formulas.guardrails_tests: opening storage must be within derived curve range; no silent extrapolation; otherwise selected proportional fallback may be used for evaporation only
formulas.notes: Accepted for Design 2 v1.0 freeze. Design 2 v1.1: optional advanced method; no longer required for standard field calculation.

formulas.name: Stage-specific evaporation area
formulas.formula_logic: area = linear interpolation of water surface area at STG-003 current depth
formulas.guardrails_tests: observed range only; no extrapolation; monotonic validated curve
formulas.notes: Design 2 v1.1: optional advanced method; no longer required for standard field calculation.

formulas.name: Stage-specific infiltration area
formulas.formula_logic: area = linear interpolation of physically applicable wetted-base area at STG-003 current depth
formulas.guardrails_tests: unlined route only; observed range only; no surface-area substitution; no extrapolation
formulas.notes: Design 2 v1.1: optional advanced method; no longer required for standard field calculation.

formulas.name: Evaporation area router — proportional standard
formulas.formula_logic: standard: evaporation_area = full_surface_area_m2 * fill_fraction; advanced only: use BAL-014 when explicitly selected
formulas.inputs_dependencies: area_method, full_surface_area_m2, fill_fraction, optional stage-area data
formulas.guardrails_tests: standard is proportional; exactly one method; 0<=area<=full surface area
formulas.notes: v1.1 standard field method is proportional. Stage-area is optional advanced, not mandatory.

formulas.name: Available water
formulas.formula_logic: day1_available = generated_runoff + 0; later available = generated_runoff + previous_closing_storage
formulas.guardrails_tests: standard run begins with zero storage; assumption in manifest

formulas.name: Opening storage
formulas.formula_logic: opening_storage = min(available_water, eligible_capacity)
formulas.guardrails_tests: capacity >=0; opening >=0

formulas.name: Overflow
formulas.formula_logic: overflow = max(0, available_water - opening_storage)
formulas.guardrails_tests: non-negative

formulas.name: Fill fraction
formulas.formula_logic: fill_fraction = opening_storage / eligible_capacity
formulas.guardrails_tests: eligible_capacity >0; if capacity=0 route is not calculation-ready; 0..1

formulas.name: Potential evaporation
formulas.formula_logic: potential_evap_m3 = evaporation_area_m2 * evaporation_mm_day / 1000
formulas.guardrails_tests: inputs/output >=0

formulas.name: Actual evaporation safeguard
formulas.formula_logic: actual_evaporation = min(opening_storage, max(0,potential_evaporation))
formulas.guardrails_tests: cannot exceed opening stored water

formulas.name: Potential infiltration — selected base area
formulas.formula_logic: potential_infiltration_m3 = selected_infiltration_area_m2 * infiltration_mm_hour * 24 / 1000
formulas.inputs_dependencies: BAL-017 selected infiltration area + canonical infiltration rate
formulas.guardrails_tests: unlined route only; selected area >=0; result >=0
formulas.notes: v1.1 default selected area is one verified base-area measurement.

formulas.name: Actual infiltration safeguard
formulas.formula_logic: actual_infiltration = min(max(0,opening_storage-actual_evaporation), max(0,potential_infiltration))
formulas.inputs_dependencies: opening storage, actual evaporation, potential infiltration
formulas.guardrails_tests: cannot exceed water remaining after evaporation

formulas.name: Closing storage
formulas.formula_logic: closing_storage = max(0, opening_storage - actual_evaporation - actual_infiltration)
formulas.inputs_dependencies: opening storage, actual evaporation, actual infiltration
formulas.guardrails_tests: 0<=closing<=eligible capacity

formulas.name: Captured runoff
formulas.formula_logic: captured_runoff = generated_runoff - overflow
formulas.guardrails_tests: non-negative within tolerance

formulas.name: Mass-balance residual
formulas.formula_logic: residual = previous_closing + generated - overflow - actual_evaporation - actual_infiltration - closing
formulas.guardrails_tests: abs(residual) <= numeric_tolerance before published rounding

formulas.name: KPI 1.1.1 net water potential
formulas.formula_logic: kpi_m3 = cumulative_actual_infiltration + final_closing_storage; crosscheck = cumulative_captured_runoff - cumulative_actual_evaporation
formulas.guardrails_tests: primary and cross-check identities reconcile within tolerance; retain all components

formulas.name: KPI 1.1.2 single-fill potential
formulas.formula_logic: new structure: selected eligible single-fill capacity; rejuvenation: selected incremental capacity from exactly REJ-001 or REJ-002
formulas.guardrails_tests: no reporting-year daily rainfall simulation; rejuvenation methods never additive

formulas.name: Fully lined farm pond single-fill component
formulas.formula_logic: eligible lined pond potential = eligible/intervention-attributable single-fill capacity when lining + inlet + outlet + catchment/rainfall evidence gates pass
formulas.inputs_dependencies: lining status, inlet/outlet, eligible capacity, evidence
formulas.guardrails_tests: do not apply unlined infiltration route; keep separate component

formulas.name: Lined pond aggregation
formulas.formula_logic: sum eligible lined-pond results by assurance status in a dedicated component
formulas.guardrails_tests: never silently merge into KPI 1.1.1/1.1.2 under current baseline

formulas.name: Paid labour
formulas.formula_logic: paid_person_days = verified_direct_paid_days
formulas.guardrails_tests: reporting period + muster/payment evidence

formulas.name: Community contribution
formulas.formula_logic: community_person_days = verified_hours / 8
formulas.guardrails_tests: hours >=0; time records consistent

formulas.name: Work-volume estimate
formulas.formula_logic: estimated_person_days = certified_work_quantity / approved_productivity_norm
formulas.inputs_dependencies: certified quantity, matching quantity unit, approved productivity norm
formulas.guardrails_tests: norm >0; only when direct records unavailable for same scope

formulas.name: Machinery-support labour
formulas.formula_logic: count verified operator/driver/helper labour days/hours converted to person-days; exclude machine output itself
formulas.guardrails_tests: deduplicate against paid category

formulas.name: Deduplication and category exclusivity
formulas.formula_logic: flag exact/near transaction duplicates using person+date+work scope; enforce direct-vs-volume and paid-vs-machinery exclusivity for same labour scope
formulas.guardrails_tests: never silently delete/merge; correction/selection is auditable

formulas.name: KPI 1.2.1 total
formulas.formula_logic: total_person_days = eligible_paid + eligible_community + eligible_volume_estimate + eligible_machinery_support after PD-005
formulas.guardrails_tests: reporting-year filter; category subtotals disclosed

formulas.name: Internal precision and tolerance
formulas.formula_logic: compute in full IEEE-754 precision; equality tolerance = max(1e-6 m3, 1e-9 * max(1,abs(lhs),abs(rhs)))
formulas.guardrails_tests: rounding never occurs inside formula chain; only presentation/export formatting

formulas.name: Publication rounding
formulas.formula_logic: retain raw values; default display: m3=3 decimals, BL=9 decimals, person-days=2 decimals, percent=2 decimals
formulas.guardrails_tests: export raw numeric value alongside formatted display where practical; no destructive rounding

formulas.name: Daily evaporation rate from monthly mean
formulas.formula_logic: evaporation_mm_day(date) = monthly_mean_daily_evaporation[calendar_month(date)]
formulas.inputs_dependencies: 12 monthly mean daily evaporation values Jan..Dec, mm/day; simulation date
formulas.guardrails_tests: For a full FY all 12 months must be populated; 29-Feb uses February value; values >=0; no daily interpolation required.
formulas.notes: Standard field input uses only 12 monthly values.

formulas.name: Full surface area source for standard evaporation
formulas.formula_logic: full_surface_area = measured_full_surface_area when supplied; otherwise use disclosed derived storage_plan_area when the active geometry route supports it
formulas.inputs_dependencies: measured full surface area or CAP-003 storage plan area
formulas.guardrails_tests: area >0; source flag retained; no silent geometry substitution if active structure formula does not support the derived plan area
formulas.notes: Keeps field input simple while retaining a traceable fallback.

formulas.name: Verified base area — standard infiltration area
formulas.formula_logic: standard_infiltration_area_m2 = verified_base_area_m2
formulas.inputs_dependencies: verified base area from MB/design/field measurement
formulas.guardrails_tests: required and >0 for standard unlined KPI 1.1.1; evidence/source retained

formulas.name: Infiltration area method router
formulas.formula_logic: if area_method='Standard': use BAL-016 verified base area; if area_method='Advanced stage-area': use BAL-015
formulas.inputs_dependencies: area calculation method, verified base area, optional stage-area curve
formulas.guardrails_tests: exactly one method; Standard is default; advanced requires valid STG-001..003 and BAL-015
formulas.notes: Prevents stage-area from becoming a compulsory field requirement.

WTR-111-NEW: STG-001..003/BAL-014/BAL-015 only if Advanced stage-area is selected
